mapper.sql: select id, shop_code, purchasecode as purchase_code, detailcode as detail_code, lineno as line_no, goodscode as goods_code, goodsname as goods_name, spec, unit, qty, price as unit_price, amount, coalesce(taxrate, 0) as tax_rate, coalesce(taxamount, 0) as tax_amount, warehousecode as warehouse_code, warehousename as warehouse_name, receivedqty as received_qty, batchcode as batch_code, serialnumbers as serial_numbers, remark from sdsshop.u_p_purchasedetail
mapper.select: where shop_code = #{shopCode} and purchasecode = #{purchaseCode} and detailcode = #{detailCode}
mapper.insert: insert into sdsshop.u_p_purchasedetail( shop_code, purchasecode, detailcode, lineno, goodscode, goodsname, spec, unit, qty, price, amount, taxrate, taxamount, warehousecode, warehousename, receivedqty, remainingqty, batchcode, serialnumbers, remark ) values( #{shopCode}, #{purchaseCode}, #{detailCode}, #{lineNo}, #{goodsCode}, #{goodsName}, #{spec}, #{unit}, #{qty}, #{unitPrice}, #{amount}, coalesce(#{taxRate}, 0), coalesce(#{taxAmount}, 0), #{warehouseCode}, #{warehouseName}, coalesce(#{receivedQty}, 0), #{qty} - coalesce(#{receivedQty}, 0), #{batchCode}, #{serialNumbersText}, #{remark} )

insert into sdsshop.u_p_purchasedetail( shop_code, purchasecode, detailcode, lineno, goodscode, goodsname, spec, unit, qty, price, amount, taxrate, taxamount, warehousecode, warehousename, receivedqty, remainingqty, batchcode, serialnumbers, remark ) values
( #{item.shopCode}, #{item.purchaseCode}, #{item.detailCode}, #{item.lineNo}, #{item.goodsCode}, #{item.goodsName}, #{item.spec}, #{item.unit}, #{item.qty}, #{item.unitPrice}, #{item.amount}, coalesce(#{item.taxRate}, 0), coalesce(#{item.taxAmount}, 0), #{item.warehouseCode}, #{item.warehouseName}, coalesce(#{item.receivedQty}, 0), #{item.qty} - coalesce(#{item.receivedQty}, 0), #{item.batchCode}, #{item.serialNumbersText}, #{item.remark} )
mapper.update: update sdsshop.u_p_purchasedetail set goodscode = #{goodsCode}, goodsname = #{goodsName}, spec = #{spec}, unit = #{unit}, qty = #{qty}, price = #{unitPrice}, amount = #{amount}, taxrate = coalesce(#{taxRate}, 0), taxamount = coalesce(#{taxAmount}, 0), warehousecode = #{warehouseCode}, warehousename = #{warehouseName}, remainingqty = #{qty} - coalesce(receivedqty, 0), batchcode = #{batchCode}, serialnumbers = #{serialNumbersText}, remark = #{remark} where id = #{id} and shop_code = #{shopCode}

update sdsshop.u_p_purchasedetail set receivedqty = coalesce(receivedqty, 0) + #{incrementQty}, remainingqty = qty - (coalesce(receivedqty, 0) + #{incrementQty}) where shop_code = #{shopCode} and id = #{id} and #{incrementQty} > 0 and coalesce(receivedqty, 0) + #{incrementQty} <= qty
